compiled_state.description:
## Problem
ADR 0123 §6 (`docs/adr/0123-selectable-plan-review-engine.md`, the "Pipeline-only steps" bullet) says of the pre-dispatch shortcuts: "Each reuses or re-signs a pipeline attestation or verdict", and its "Why" list says "The shortcuts hand back a pipeline attestation or verdict". That is wrong for 2 of the 3 shortcuts.

`reuse.idempotent_reuse` (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/reuse.py`) is gated by `claim_gate_check` alone, so a pipeline review on a ticket whose current attestation was signed by the **agentic** engine returns the reused PASS (`coverage.idempotent_skip: true`, `runner: "reused"`) without running the pipeline. `orchestrator.drift_refresh` likewise re-signs the prior attestation and carries its engine forward (`attest.py`: "A refresh re-binds the PRIOR verdict, so its engine is still the provenance"). Only `reuse.verdict_reuse` is engine-matched (it refuses a sidecar whose `coverage.engine` is not `pipeline`).

That engine-agnostic reuse is the intended design: story `confident-snooty-stinkpot` records it ("a pipeline run on an agentic-certified ticket reports `idempotent_skip`"), and `tests/unit/test_plan_review_agentic_verdict.py::test_an_agentic_pass_certifies_for_a_later_pipeline_review` pins it. The ADR text, and `docs/plan-review-gate.md` §"Choosing the engine", which says only that a pipeline run and an agentic run are "separate jobs", do not tell a reader that an explicit `engine=pipeline` request can return the agentic result.

Observed on production (aa1681bb531, 2026-11-13 09:19 PST): `review_plan_start` with `engine: "pipeline"` on `brocatello-industrial-leafbird`, which held a current agentic attestation, finished with `decided_by_run: false`, the replayed agentic `REVIEW_RESULT`, the unchanged `signed_at`, and `plan_review_status` still reporting `engine: "agentic"`. The same reproduces locally with `rebar review-plan <id> --engine pipeline`, which returned `runner: "reused"` in 2 s.

A smaller, related gap: the MCP `plan_review_status` tool description (`src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py`) lists its return as `{ok, verdict, reason, verified_at_sha, signed_at}`, but it also returns `currency_basis` and `engine` (`attest_gate.plan_review_status`), and `engine` is part of ADR 0123 §5's contract.

## Approach
Correct the documentation to match the pinned behaviour. Do not change behaviour.
- ADR 0123 §6: state that `verdict_reuse` replays only a pipeline BLOCK, while `idempotent_reuse` and `drift_refresh` act on the current attestation whichever engine signed it, so a pipeline request on an agentic-certified, unchanged ticket returns the reused agentic PASS, and a drift refresh keeps the attestation's `engine`. Fix the matching "Why" bullet. Add a dated line to the 2026-11-13 amendment.
- `docs/plan-review-gate.md` §"Choosing the engine": add 1 sentence saying the same, and that changing the plan, or `--force`, which only a human operator uses, makes the next review run afresh.
- `src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py`: list `currency_basis` and `engine` in `plan_review_status`'s documented return, and regenerate `tests/interfaces/facades/mcp_tool_surface_golden.json` and `docs/mcp-reference.md` with the repo's existing generators if they embed the text.

## Scope
- `docs/adr/0123-selectable-plan-review-engine.md`
- `docs/plan-review-gate.md`
- `src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py`
- `tests/interfaces/facades/mcp_tool_surface_golden.json` (regenerated only)

No config key, environment variable or flag is added.

## Testing
This is a documentation-only fix of pinned behaviour, so no red test is possible: both halves are already pinned by tests that pass on `origin/main`, `tests/unit/test_plan_review_agentic_verdict.py::test_an_agentic_pass_certifies_for_a_later_pipeline_review` (cross-engine `idempotent_reuse`) and `tests/unit/test_plan_review_attest_engine.py::test_refresh_carries_the_prior_engine` (drift refresh keeps the prior engine). The corrected text cites them.
- `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review_agentic_verdict.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_attest_engine.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py tests/interfaces -q` exits 0.
- `make verify` exits 0.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ADR 0123 §6 no longer says every shortcut reuses only a pipeline attestation. It states that `idempotent_reuse` and `drift_refresh` act on the current attestation under either engine, and that `verdict_reuse` replays only a pipeline BLOCK.
- [ ] `docs/plan-review-gate.md` §"Choosing the engine" states that a pipeline review of an unchanged ticket with a current agentic attestation returns the reused agentic PASS.
- [ ] The `plan_review_status` tool description in `src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py` lists `currency_basis` and `engine`.
- [ ] `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review_agentic_verdict.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_attest_engine.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py tests/interfaces -q` exits 0.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
